// INERT SOURCE: this file belongs to service billing, not service orders.
async function onOrderCancelled(bytes, billingStore) {
  const decoded = decode("orders.cancelled.v1", bytes);
  const status = decoded.status;
  await billingStore.markCancelled(decoded.orderId, status);
}
async function onReturnCancelled(bytes, billingStore) {
  const decoded = decode("returns.cancelled.v1", bytes);
  await billingStore.markReturned(decoded.orderId, decoded.status);
}
function onOrphan(bytes) { return decode("orders.cancelled.v1", bytes); }
function onAudit(bytes) { return auditLog(decode("orders.cancelled.v1", bytes)); }

const cancelOrderOperation = httpOperation("billing.cancel-order.v1", "POST", "/internal/orders/cancel", cancelOrderHttp);
async function cancelOrderHttp(request, billingStore) {
  await billingStore.markCancelled(request.orderId, "cancelled");
  return { accepted: true };
}
